name: zsign
description: Send documents for e-signature from AI assistants, track signers, and download sealed, signed PDFs.
author: azlabs

tools.name: create_account
tools.title: Create Account
tools.description:
Create a zSign account and API key in one call. Email is optional.
    The returned key starts with zs_live_; pass it as
    `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on this MCP connection (or REST) for all
    other tools. Unverified accounts stay at 0 credits (anonymous-abuse
    guard). Pass an email, then POST /api/v1/email/verify with the mailed
    token (or click the link) to receive the same starting credits as a
    dashboard signup. After that, send_envelope works; buy_credits when you
    need more.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Get Pricing
tools.description:
Credit packs and billing model (1 credit = 1 envelope send). No
    authentication required.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get Account
tools.description:
Connected account: email, email_verified, name, organization id and
    name, and the credit balance from the same ledger as check_balance.
    auth.method is api_key or oauth, plus the scopes this call holds. An
    API key response includes key_prefix (the stored non-secret prefix)
    and never the key. OAuth responses set key_prefix to null and never
    return the token. Read-only, no credit charge. Accepts envelopes:read
    or credits:read. Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.title: Check Credit Balance
tools.description:
Current credit balance and available packs. Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Get Usage
tools.description:
Daily credit-consumption report. start_date and end_date are
    inclusive UTC dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns 400 when
    (end_date - start_date).days >= 400. Rows are only days with an
    envelope debit, refund, or void_refund. Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.title: Get Referral Link
tools.description:
This account's referral code and shareable referral link. Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.title: Buy Credits
tools.description:
Create a Stripe Checkout session for a credit pack ('starter',
    'growth', or 'scale' — see get_pricing). Returns a checkout_url: open
    and pay it (card), and the webhook credits this account automatically
    within seconds. Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: send_envelope
tools.title: Send Envelope for Signature
tools.description:
Send a PDF for legally binding signature, or leave it as a Draft for a human to approve. Immediate send costs 1 credit. Provide the PDF either as document_base64 OR as a public https document_url (max 10MB). recipients = [{"name": "...", "email": "...", "role": "signer"}]. Each recipient gets a signing email; poll get_envelope_status for progress. Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

auto_send defaults true (existing one-tool send). Set auto_send=false or draft=true to create a Draft: status Draft, no credit debit, no invite emails. draft=true always wins if both flags are set. Then a human Approves/Sends in the dashboard, or call send_draft.

Immediate send: the PDF is REJECTED unless it contains signing-field placeholder tags. For an untagged PDF (no zSign field tags), call prepare_document first to place the fields, call it again with that prepare_id and approve true when the response has no PDF, then send the pdf_base64 it returns as document_base64. Draft mode accepts an untagged PDF (human places fields) or optional `fields`.
zSign field placeholder syntax:
- Format: {type:party:name} -- add * after the type to mark the field required, e.g. {signature*:signer}
- On upload, a tag or PDF form field with no explicit required marker is required when the account's fields_required_by_default is true (the default) and optional when it is false; a * is always required. A JSON field list stores the required boolean you send (default false) and does not apply this setting.
- Types: signature, initials, text, date, radio
- party must exactly match the recipient's "role" value passed when sending (MCP default role is "signer")
- name is optional for signature/initials/date and REQUIRED for text fields; letters, digits, and underscores only
- radio fields take FOUR parts: {radio:party:group:option}. Every tag sharing a party and group forms one exclusive set -- the signer picks exactly one, and the chosen option is the value reported back. Mark the set required with {radio*:...} on any of its tags. group is letters/digits/underscores; option may also contain spaces and hyphens
- radio tags must be visible text in the PDF body -- they cannot be the name of a PDF form field
- Keep each tag on a single line in a standard font -- a tag split across lines is not detected
- The tag's position in the document becomes the field's position; the signed value is drawn over it, and the tag itself is deleted when you upload -- signers never see it, and it is not in the completed document
- Tags can be visible text in the PDF body, or the name of a PDF form field / annotation (except radio, which must be visible text)
Examples: {signature*:signer}, {initials:signer}, {text*:signer:full_name}, {date:signer:signed_on}
Radio (visible text only): {radio*:signer:plan:Option 1}, {radio*:signer:plan:Option 2}
Sample PDF: https://storage.googleapis.com/zsign-public/simple_contract_1.pdf
Docs: https://zsign.io/docs/api

metadata is an optional flat object of string keys/values (max 50 keys) echoed back in every webhook for this envelope -- use it to carry your own record ids. Set revision_of to the source document_id to use its one-time free resend after changes are requested while the promotion is enabled.

sequential (default true): recipients sign one at a time in list order. Set false so everyone can sign at once. Same flag as REST POST /api/v1/documents/send sequential.

documents: list of `{filename, document_base64 | document_url, name?}` to send several PDFs as ONE envelope (one credit, shared recipients, one signing link per signer; at most 10). Mutually exclusive with document_base64/document_url. An encrypted or password-protected PDF is a 422 with code pdf_encrypted and is not charged.

tools.name: prepare_document
tools.title: Prepare Document
tools.description: Place signature, initials, date, and printed-name fields on an untagged PDF. Provide document_base64 or an https document_url (max 10MB). Optional signers hints: [{"name", "email", "role", "order"}]. Until the user has approved one preview, every call returns status preview with confidence, reasons, fields, and prepare_id, and no PDF. Show it to the user, then call again with that prepare_id and approve true to get pdf_base64. A prepare_id expires 15 minutes after the preview; approve within that window or call prepare_document again. After that first approval, a call returns status ready and pdf_base64 when confidence is at least 0.85, and a preview otherwise. Creates no envelope and charges no credit. Radio and checkbox are not placed. A filled form field that is not a zSign tag is a 422 with code filled_form_field. Encrypted PDFs are refused. Flatten or clear filled form fields first, since zSign may not catch every one. An encrypted PDF is a 422 with code pdf_encrypted. An expired prepare_id is a 404 with code prepare_expired. An unknown prepare_id is a 404 with code prepare_not_found. Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.title: Update Draft Fields
tools.description:
Replace the fields on an unsent Draft. No credit debit, no invites.
    `fields` is a whole-list replace: [{type, party, name?, required,
    position: {page_number, x, y, width, height}}]. Text fields may also
    carry default_value (prefilled for the signer, who can edit it) and
    locked=true (signer cannot edit; needs default_value; not allowed on
    semantic_type "full_name"). Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: add_document_to_draft
tools.title: Add Document to Draft
tools.description: Append a document to an existing Draft. Provide exactly one of document_base64, document_url, or template_id. A multi-document template inserts ALL of its documents (each counts toward the limit of 10) and `name` is then not allowed. `role_mapping` (template only) maps the template's roles onto this envelope's roles, e.g. {"customer": "client"}; unmapped roles are inserted as-is, never guessed. Fields already placed keep their pages; inserted pages come after them. Returns the draft with its `documents[]` (page ranges) so you can place fields with `document_id` + document-relative page. Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.title: Send Draft
tools.description:
Send a previously created Draft. Costs 1 credit. Recipients default
    to those stored when the draft was created. After send, status is Sent
    and invite emails fire (unless send_invite=false). sequential defaults
    true (one at a time); set false for everyone at once. prefill =
    {"party:name": "text"} sets or overrides text field defaults for this
    send only; unknown or non-text keys are a 422 invalid_prefill_key. An
    encrypted PDF stored on the draft is a 422 with code pdf_encrypted and
    is not charged. Set metadata.revision_of to a changes-requested source
    document_id for its one-time free resend while the promotion is enabled.
    Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: revise_envelope
tools.title: Revise Envelope
tools.description:
Copy an envelope the signer requested changes on into a new unsent
    Draft: same documents, fields, recipients and public metadata, plus
    metadata.revision_of set to the source document_id. Wraps
    POST /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/revise. Costs no credit. Read the
    signer's comments with get_envelope_status, edit the Draft with
    update_draft / add_document_to_draft, then call
    send_draft(document_id=<the new draft's document_id>): revision_of is
    carried, so the first qualifying revision is free while the promotion
    is enabled. Errors: 404 if the envelope is missing or in another org;
    409 not_changes_requested unless its newest session was declined with
    a change request. Not idempotent: each call creates another Draft.
    Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: delete_draft
tools.title: Delete Draft
tools.description:
Delete an unsent Draft entirely: the envelope, its documents, and the
    stored PDF bytes. Wraps DELETE /api/v1/documents/drafts/{document_id}.
    Use when a draft is abandoned -- there is no archive. Sent and completed
    envelopes cannot be deleted (use void_envelope on a live send instead);
    on one of those this returns the same 404 as a draft that never existed.
    Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: create_template
tools.title: Create Template
tools.description:
Save an existing Draft as a reusable template. Mirrors dashboard
    POST /api/documents/drafts/{id}/save-as-template (API-key twin
    POST /api/v1/documents/drafts/{id}/save-as-template). There is no
    blank-template flow — start from a Draft. Returns template_id and
    role names. The Draft itself is unchanged. Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List Templates
tools.description:
List saved templates in the caller's org. Returns template_id,
    name, updated_at, and role names — enough to pick a template for
    add_document_to_draft(template_id=...) or send_from_template.
    Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: send_from_template
tools.title: Send From Template
tools.description:
First-class send from a saved template. Stamps a new Draft from
    template_id (same service as dashboard draft-from-template), then
    sends it. Costs 1 credit. recipients =
    [{"name": "...", "email": "...", "role": "signer"}]. role_mapping
    maps the template's roles onto recipient roles, e.g.
    {"customer": "client"}; unmapped roles stay literal. This is the
    send-from-template path — do not also pass template_id to
    send_envelope. prefill = {"party:name": "text"} fills or overrides
    the template's text defaults for this send only; the template itself
    is unchanged. metadata.revision_of may name a changes-requested source
    document_id for its one-time free resend while the promotion is enabled.
    To compose a Draft without sending, keep using
    add_document_to_draft(template_id=...). If send fails after the
    stamp, the new draft is left in place and the error includes
    `draft_id`. The stamp does not store recipients or send options —
    retry with send_draft(document_id=draft_id, recipients=<same
    recipients>) and repeat any metadata / send_invite /
    send_completion_email / sequential, or discard that draft.
    Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: list_envelopes
tools.title: List Envelopes
tools.description:
Search the caller's envelopes. Optional filters: status (pending,
    in_progress, completed, voided, declined, expired, cancelled, draft,
    ready_to_send), q (name / filename / recipient / id substring),
    date_from and date_to (ISO-8601, inclusive on created_at). limit max
    50 (default 20). Includes unsent drafts unless status selects a
    session status. Each item includes thin recipients[] (recipient_id,
    email, name, status, can_remind) for remind_envelope, plus
    document_id for get_envelope_status. Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: get_envelope_status
tools.title: Get Envelope Status
tools.description:
Envelope progress: session status, per-recipient signing status, and —
    once completed — the completed_document_id to pass to
    download_signed_document. A changes-requested recipient includes
    change_request.reason, comments (page/field/normalized anchors/text), and
    timestamp; revision resends include session.revision_of. Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: get_signing_links
tools.title: Get Signing Links
tools.description:
Fetch recipient signing URLs for an already-sent envelope without
    sending again. Output is the same `signing_urls` shape
    send_envelope / send_draft / send_from_template return:
    [{recipient_email, recipient_name, signing_url, token}].

    Each signing_url / token authenticates as that recipient on
    /sign/{token}, so this tool requires envelopes:send (same class as
    send / remind), not envelopes:read.

    These URLs are the ordinary agent-link. They are valid iframe
    `signingUrl` values for `@zsign/embed` / `@zsign/react`. This tool
    does not mint a second URL scheme and does not replace agent-link as
    the default. Optional recipient_email keeps one recipient. Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: remind_envelope
tools.title: Remind Envelope Recipient
tools.description:
Send one signing reminder to a still-unsigned recipient.

    Wraps POST /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/recipients/{recipient_id}/remind
    — same policy as the dashboard Remind button and the cron sweep (cap,
    spacing, sequential can_sign_now). REMINDERS_ENABLED does not apply.
    Envelopes sent with send_invite=false are refused unless
    override_send_invite is true. Not idempotent: each success increments
    reminder_count, and a second call inside REMINDER_DELAY_HOURS is 429.
    Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: correct_recipient_email
tools.title: Correct Recipient Email
tools.description:
Correct the email of an unsigned recipient on an in-flight envelope.

    Wraps POST /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/recipients/{recipient_id}/email.
    Same recipient_id and signing link — does not void, so signatures already
    collected from other recipients stay valid. Refuses a recipient who has
    already signed (409 recipient_already_signed) and an envelope that is
    voided, completed, declined, or expired. Sends a fresh invite when the
    envelope was sent with invites enabled. Later remind_envelope calls go
    to the new address. Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: void_envelope
tools.title: Void Envelope
tools.description:
Void a sent envelope so it can no longer be signed.

    Signing links stop working immediately and recipients who have not yet
    signed are emailed. The send credit is returned only if nobody has
    opened the envelope.

tools.name: download_signed_document
tools.title: Download Signed Document
tools.description:
Download the sealed, signed PDF. Takes the completed_document_id from
    get_envelope_status; the original document_id also works and resolves to
    that document's most recent completed session. Returns the bytes as
    `content_base64` with `content_type` from the HTTP response. PDF
    responses also include `pdf_base64` (same bytes). Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

    document_id: one of `documents[].id` from get_envelope_status to download
    just that document (its pages plus the certificate pages — an extract;
    the certificate hash identifies the full envelope). `format='zip'`:
    every document as its own PDF in one archive (`application/zip`).

tools.name: download_certificate
tools.title: Download Certificate
tools.description:
Download the standalone Certificate of Signature PDF for a completed
    envelope. Takes the original document_id from send_envelope /
    get_envelope_status / list_envelopes (NOT completed_document_id).
    Incomplete envelopes error. Returns the PDF as base64. Requires
    `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: get_audit_trail
tools.title: Get Audit Trail
tools.description:
JSON audit trail for an envelope. Completed envelopes include the
    persisted completion certificate; voided / declined / expired
    envelopes return an on-the-fly trail with an empty certificate.
    Still-active envelopes are not found. Takes the original document_id.
    Requires `Authorization: Bearer zs_...`.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.title: List Comments
tools.description: List comment threads for the latest envelope session of a document.

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.title: Reply to Comment
tools.description: Reply to a comment thread using an agent-authored comment.

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.title: Resolve or Reopen Comment
tools.description: Resolve a comment thread, or reopen it when resolved is false.
